raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified “royals.se” as an official/authoritative site and repeatedly instructed searches restricted to that domain, using misspelled/garbled diacritics (e.g., “ ngermanland” instead of Ångermanland; “H lsingland and G strikland”). This led to consistent “no results” and misdirected the WebSurfer, impeding confirmation from the correct official site (kungahuset.se).
